mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tasks (id, user_id, template_id, template_title, request_id, request_fingerprint, status, current_stage, simulation_config_json, created_at, started_at, finished_at, result_path, error_code, error_message) VALUES (#{id}, #{userId}, #{templateId}, #{templateTitle}, #{requestId}, #{requestFingerprint}, #{status}, #{currentStage}, #{simulationConfigJson}, #{createdAt}, #{startedAt}, #{finishedAt}, #{resultPath}, #{errorCode}, #{errorMessage})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM tasks WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
SELECT * FROM tasks WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND request_id = #{requestId}
SELECT * FROM tasks WHERE status = 'QUEUED' ORDER BY created_at, id LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM tasks WHERE ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT * FROM tasks WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status IN ('QUEUED', 'RUNNING') ORDER BY created_at, id
